title: Abram and Lot Go Separate Ways

verses.1: Abram left Egypt and traveled back to the Negeb, along with his wife, everything he owned, and Lot.
verses.2: By this time Abram had become very wealthy, with large flocks, silver, and gold.
verses.3: From the Negeb he traveled all the way back to Bethel, to the place where he had camped before, between Bethel and Ai,
verses.4: where he had built an altar the first time. There Abram called on the name of the LORD.
verses.5: Lot, who was traveling with Abram, also had flocks, herds, and tents.
verses.6: But the land could not support both of them living there together. They had so many animals and possessions that there was not enough room for both of them.
verses.7: Arguments broke out between Abram's herdsmen and Lot's herdsmen over the land. At that time the Canaanites and Perizzites were also living in the land.
verses.8: Abram said to Lot, "Let us not have any quarreling between us or between our herdsmen, because we are family.
verses.9: The whole land is before you. Let us go our separate ways. If you go left, I will go right. If you go right, I will go left."
verses.10: Lot looked out and saw that the whole Jordan Valley was well watered everywhere, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, all the way toward Zoar. This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.11: So Lot chose the whole Jordan Valley for himself and traveled eastward. That is how the two of them parted ways.
verses.12: Abram stayed in the land of Canaan, while Lot settled among the cities of the plain and moved his tent close to Sodom.
verses.13: The people of Sodom were very wicked and were great sinners against the LORD.
verses.14: After Lot had gone, the LORD said to Abram, "Look around from where you are — to the north, south, east, and west.
verses.15: All the land you can see I will give to you and to your descendants forever.
verses.16: I will make your descendants as many as the dust of the earth. If anyone could count the dust, then your descendants could be counted too.
verses.17: Get up and walk through the land in every direction, because I am giving it to you."
verses.18: So Abram moved his tent and went to live near the oaks of Mamre at Hebron. There he built an altar to the LORD.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
